description:
लोन के साथ जो Insurance पालिसी ली है वो  कैंसिल कैसे करवाए

Many times banker forces customer to avail insurance policy along with new loan. many banker have made their own rule that whenever any person will avail personal loan than they will sell insurance policy to them.

In this video i have explained that Any insurance policy can be cancelled during its free look period. customer who does not want insurance policy must call customer care to cancel their insurance policy.

Murari Garg
https://wa.me/917599620000

#insurancepolicy #feeelookperiod #loanpolicy #cancel #mandatory #howto
